English: Crag Shelter
A basic windbreak of hides and rough stone, built into a mountainside for swift protection against the elements.
Rockwall Pen
A crude, stone-walled pen for keeping livestock safe from mountain predators, allowing a larger and healthier nomad community.
Cairn Lookout
A pile of stones marks a simple lookout, with a small shelter to watch for raiders or wild beasts, increasing camp security and population.
Goat Herding Ledge
Timber and stone enclosures along the slopes allow goats and sheep to be tended more efficiently, greatly boosting population and supply.
Timbered Slope Hut
Semi-permanent timbered huts on mountain slopes provide warmth and security, with reinforced pens for animals and people alike.
Mountain Watchstand
Raised watchstands provide far-reaching views and improved defense coordination, vital for mountain clans.
Guarded Ridge Camp
A series of defensible camps along the ridge, with wooden palisades and coordinated sentries, making the community formidable in the mountains.
Stone Signal Tower
A stone-built tower with fire beacons and drums, providing unmatched warning and coordination for mountain defenses.
Mountain Defended Hall
A fortified timber and stone hall, seat of the mountain clan, with strongholds for warriors and precious stores.
Peak Stronghold
An imposing stronghold atop the highest peak, complete with stone walls, stores, and command towers—a bastion of nomadic might in the mountains.
